يستجهلا (form X)
# يَسْتَجْهِلَا (yastajhilā) /jas.tad͡ʒ.hi.laː/: third-person masculine dual non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَجْهَلَ (istajhala)
# يُسْتَجْهَلَا (yustajhalā) /jus.tad͡ʒ.ha.laː/: third-person masculine dual non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَجْهَلَ (istajhala)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
